description: Search-result excerpts for S008 and S009 listed January-dated La Nation items for 11–13 and 27–30 January, respectively, but these are discovery leads only. For S008, the exact page-737 native open (R006) timed out before content; one permitted ordinary no-cookie/no-redirect request (R008) returned HTTP 200, but its index metadata was mixed/stale (date labels included October 2026 and 7–8 March 2022), had no parsed index entries, and did not corroborate the January excerpts. S009 page 722 returned no content on either the native pre-content timeout (R009) or the one ordinary fallback (R011, URLError); no HTTP status or publisher denial was observed. La Nation monthly archive page 1 of 14 was read; pages 2–14 and linked stories remain unread.
required_followup: Keep the January-dated excerpts as unverified discovery leads. After separate coordinator authorization, use selective archive/story discovery only where it could clarify dated physical action; do not mechanically read every archive page. Keep unread pages and stories as explicit gaps.

description: Nine exact-URL body requests across six distinct URLs are represented by nine metadata-only body_reads records: five earlier requests plus four window-2 requests (R006, R008, R009 and R011). Five distinct source cards returned some content (S001, S002, S004, S005 and S008), and the synchronized source ledger now marks those five opened and S003, S006, S007 and S009 search_only. S008 is opened for index metadata only: R008 returned HTTP 200 but the mixed/stale page metadata did not corroborate the January search excerpt and is not an event report. S009 remains search_only because R009 was a native pre-content timeout and R011 ended in URLError, with no HTTP status or content. No scoped publisher body denial was observed. R010 was an unused access-check receipt, not a body request. The original R006 body record remains immutable; correction_history/R006_S008.json supersedes its incorrect returned-text/read-scope interpretation. The original R001 preflight receipt was not retained: its hash is preserved in metadata, and R001_S002_postflight.json is not retroactive authorization. S002 is opened but is a verified Gabon false positive and is not Djibouti event evidence.
required_followup: Preserve the original R006 record and separate correction history; do not reconstruct the lost R001 preflight. The post-window source sync is complete. Keep S008 limited to index metadata and S009 as an unresolved search-only lead. Do not infer a publisher-wide denial from either timeout or the S009 URLError; any later body access requires a separate authorization and fresh access gate.
